scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 目 five and the 龶 top of 靑 (6-9) match, but the dictionary writes the bottom of 靑 as 円 with a short vertical hanging from the top to the bar (12) before that bar (13), where the licensed MM original draws 月 with two inner bars. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 鯖 and 猜 were for 靑·青
